PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;

BEGIN IMMEDIATE;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schema_meta (
    key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    value TEXT NOT NULL
) WITHOUT ROWID;

INSERT INTO schema_meta(key, value) VALUES ('schema_version', '2')
ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value=excluded.value;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS jobs (
    job_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    logical_trial_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    experiment_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    job_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (job_type IN (
        'feature_batch', 'lightgbm_train', 'qlib_train', 'vectorized_screen',
        'statistical_precompute', 'alphasage_smoke', 'alphasage_mine',
        'alphagen_mine', 'torch_model_train', 'representation_train'
    )),
    state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('pending','leased','completed','failed','canceled')),
    priority INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    git_sha TEXT NOT NULL,
    dataset_manifest_sha TEXT NOT NULL,
    config_sha TEXT NOT NULL,
    environment_sha TEXT NOT NULL,
    gpu_required INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (gpu_required IN (0,1)),
    checkpointable INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (checkpointable IN (0,1)),
    max_wall_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (max_wall_seconds > 0),
    trial_accounting_policy TEXT NOT NULL,
    command_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    expected_outputs_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    canonical_result_id TEXT,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_jobs_lease
ON jobs(state, gpu_required, priority DESC, created_at ASC);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_jobs_logical_trial
ON jobs(logical_trial_id);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_jobs_logical_trial
ON jobs(logical_trial_id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workers (
    worker_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    boot_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    capabilities_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('online','draining','offline','stale')),
    last_seen TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS attempts (
    attempt_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES jobs(job_id),
    worker_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workers(worker_id),
    boot_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    lease_token_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN (
        'leased','running','checkpointed','completed','failed','stale','orphaned'
    )),
    leased_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    heartbeat_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    lease_deadline TEXT NOT NULL,
    checkpoint_uri TEXT,
    checkpoint_sha TEXT,
    restart_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (restart_count >= 0),
    exit_code INTEGER,
    reconcile_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown' CHECK (
        reconcile_state IN ('unknown','valid','failed','superseded')
    ),
    finished_at TEXT
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_attempts_job ON attempts(job_id, leased_at);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_attempts_deadline ON attempts(state, lease_deadline);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS results (
    result_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    job_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES jobs(job_id),
    attempt_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES attempts(attempt_id),
    manifest_sha TEXT NOT NULL,
    manifest_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    accepted_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    registered_to_trial_ledger INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (
        registered_to_trial_ledger IN (0,1)
    )
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS orphan_results (
    orphan_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    job_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    attempt_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    manifest_sha TEXT NOT NULL,
    manifest_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    reason TEXT NOT NULL,
    received_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_orphan_attempt_manifest
ON orphan_results(attempt_id, manifest_sha);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trial_registrations (
    logical_trial_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES jobs(job_id),
    result_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES results(result_id),
    registered_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS event_outbox (
    event_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    entity_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    flushed_at TEXT
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_event_outbox_unflushed
ON event_outbox(flushed_at, event_id);

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS results_attempt_matches_job
BEFORE INSERT ON results
WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM attempts
    WHERE attempt_id=NEW.attempt_id AND job_id=NEW.job_id
)
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'result attempt does not belong to job');
END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS jobs_canonical_result_matches_job
BEFORE UPDATE OF canonical_result_id ON jobs
WHEN NEW.canonical_result_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM results
    WHERE result_id=NEW.canonical_result_id AND job_id=NEW.job_id
)
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'canonical result does not belong to job');
END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trial_registration_result_matches_job
BEFORE INSERT ON trial_registrations
WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM results
    WHERE result_id=NEW.result_id AND job_id=NEW.job_id
)
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'trial result does not belong to job');
END;

COMMIT;
